# CVDPREVENT Explorer

> An independent interface for exploring public CVDPREVENT cardiovascular prevention data across NHS organisations in England.

Use the agent skill before querying the data. It explains organisation resolution, release selection, indicator polarity, comparisons, demographic breakdowns and disclosure rules.

## Agent resources

- [CVDPREVENT agent skill](https://www.cvdprevent-explorer.app/skill.md): Start here for instructions and query recipes.
- [Response examples](https://www.cvdprevent-explorer.app/skill-examples.md): Example API response shapes and joins.
- [API reference](https://www.cvdprevent-explorer.app/api-reference.md): Route and field reference.
- [Relay guide](https://www.cvdprevent-explorer.app/skill-relay.md): Optional same-origin relay instructions for constrained clients.
- [Agent API index](https://www.cvdprevent-explorer.app/api/cvdprevent): Machine-readable resource links.
- [Indicator polarity](https://www.cvdprevent-explorer.app/api/cvdprevent/polarity): Machine-readable indicator classification and polarity.

## Explorer

- [Organisation search](https://www.cvdprevent-explorer.app/): Find an ICB, Sub-ICB, PCN or region.
- [Indicators](https://www.cvdprevent-explorer.app/indicators): Browse the indicator catalogue.
- [Benchmarks](https://www.cvdprevent-explorer.app/benchmarks): Compare NHS organisations.
- [Use with AI](https://www.cvdprevent-explorer.app/skills): Instructions for using the skill with an AI assistant.

## Notes

- CVDPREVENT Explorer is independent and is not the official CVDPREVENT Data and Improvement Tool.
- Data come from the public CVDPREVENT API.
- Results are aggregate audit data and should not be treated as clinical advice.
